children: BIO-key convened its 2026 Annual Meeting but adjourned to October 2, 2026 after insufficient votes were present to approve issuance of up to 1,236,668 shares on exercise of warrants.
Adjourned Annual Meeting to Oct. 2, 2026 at Holmdel, NJ to allow more time for stockholder votes on four proposals.
Proposal 4 (approval per NASDAQ Rule 5635(d)) lacked sufficient votes; it would approve issuance of up to 1,236,668 shares upon warrant exercise.
Record date remains July 15, 2026; stockholders who haven't voted on Proposal 4 must submit a new proxy per the Supplement.
Proxy Statement and Supplement are available on SEC and company websites; no changes to proposals or polling procedures.
